entry.title: the acceptance assay cannot run here
entry.what: assay derives the site's values from its group_vars and runs ops/validation/run-acceptance.py with python3; one of those could not start, so nothing was probed.
causes: the site name has no ops/ansible/group_vars/<site>_hosts/vars.yml, or --values names no file
python3 or PyYAML is not installed
the runner stopped with an error rather than a verdict
fixes: ls ops/ansible/group_vars/   (the site names this repository declares)
matches: the site's values could not be derived
the acceptance runner did not finish
